Siddharth Sharma PMP®
IT Project Manager

+919769319535 siddharthsharma319535@gmail.com

Summary

PMP-certified Project Manager and MBA Finance-IT graduate and almost 5 years of experience, who enjoys building and
delivering scalable digital solutions. Experienced in working across fintech, insurance, and enterprise domains, with a focus on
bringing clarity to complex requirements and driving projects to completion in fast-paced environments.

Experience

Senior Project Manager, 06/2025 - Current

Enpointe.IO, Andheri West

Led end-to-end delivery of cinema booking and payment systems, managing web, app, and backend integrations

Managed integrations with payment gateways including Cybersource and Dibsy, ensuring secure and seamless
transaction processing

Drove implementation of payment workflows, wallet systems, and offer logic, improving checkout experience and
user conversion

Coordinated cross-functional teams to deliver features across booking, F&B ordering, and in-seat service platforms

Oversaw API integrations and system enhancements, ensuring reliability and performance across high-traffic booking
environments

Technical Project Manager, 03/2023 - 05/2025

WEQ Technologies, Andheri East

Delivered web and mobile products across fintech, insurance, and enterprise domains, managing end-to-end lifecycles
in 3–4 month release cycles

Led cross-functional teams to deliver solutions across fintech, insurance, and enterprise domains, ensuring
execution against timelines and quality benchmarks

Delivered a SaaS platform for general insurance and health insurance organizations

Allowing end users to use modules related to wealth management, financial management and redeem the loyalty
pointers to increase persistency.

Project Manager, 06/2021 - 03/2023

Sarjak Container Liners, Andheri West

Led end-to-end delivery of enterprise and financial systems, including ERP, payment workflows, and automation
solutions (RPA, OCR)

Managed cross-functional teams to deliver multiple product initiatives, ensuring seamless execution of transaction and
operational workflows

Spearheaded automation using RPA and OCR, reducing manual processing and improving efficiency in financial and
backend operations



Education

BSC Information Technology, 2016 - 2019

Vivek College- University Of Mumbai, Mumbai

MBA - Information Technology, 2019 - 2021

NMITD, Mumbai

Skills

Risk Management Technical Leadership

Stakeholder Management Change Management

Budget Oversight Agile & Scrum

objectives
